items.text: Indianapolis traded LG Quenton Nelson to Seattle and DT DeForest Buckner to San Francisco on Oct. 27; neither plays for the Colts on Sunday.

Indianapolis (Wednesday walkthrough, estimated): CB Justin Walley (knee) and LB Bryce Boettcher (groin) did not practice; CB Sauce Gardner (calf), G Matt Goncalves (ankle) and TE Tyler Warren (groin) were limited. CB Cam Taylor-Britt (groin) and WR Alec Pierce (heel) are on IR.

Jacksonville (Wednesday): S Antonio Johnson (ankle) did not practice; WR Jakobi Meyers (hamstring), LB Jahlani Tavai (hamstring) and DT Ruke Orhorhoro (ankle) were limited. LT Anton Harrison (torn ACL) is out for the season.

adjust.reason: Indianapolis just traded Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner and has three of its top four cornerbacks hurt plus TE Tyler Warren limited, against Jacksonville's loss of LT Anton Harrison. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
